fusions.name: Hold Fast
fusions.desc: A gripping shove that deals 4 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds and has a 20% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Clamped Shut
fusions.desc: Clamps down on every enemy within 3 tiles, which deals 10 damage, strips 17% armour for 8 seconds and slows each by 18%, then stuns each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Pulling Together
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Finishing Grip
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage. Your armour rises by 5%.
